summary: Enhance your skills with our Data and Information Governance Training Course. Learn best practices and compliance strategies to manage data effectively.
lede: Information governance training helps data stewards, governance managers, and privacy or security leads establish accountable data ownership and controls. Participants practise defining decision rights, creating business glossaries and data-quality scorecards, and designing classification, access, and information lifecycle workflows. They also assess governance maturity and develop roadmaps to prioritize improvements and report progress.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate course suits professionals who influence data ownership, information controls, quality, privacy, security, or digital reporting. It is designed for role holders who need a practical governance operating model rather than a purely conceptual introduction.
prerequisites: No formal certification or programming experience is required. You should have practical exposure to business data, reporting, information systems, compliance, privacy, security, records, or operational processes. Basic familiarity with spreadsheets and organizational policies will help. Coding is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted classification, data catalogues, and automated controls are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not technical engineering level.
